data.one_liner: A weekly date picker widget to scroll between weeks and select dates.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable weekly date picker widget that lets users scroll through weeks and select a specific date. It supports hiding week text, setting custom colors, and restricting the number of selectable weekdays.
use_when: You need a compact horizontal date picker showing a week at a time
You want to allow users to scroll between weeks and pick a day
avoid_when: You need a traditional full-month calendar grid picker
You require complex date range selections
strengths: Easy to integrate with standard Flutter state management
Supports custom styling including colors and number of visible weekdays
Handles leap years and daylight savings properly
weaknesses: Limited to weekly horizontal scrolling views
Does not support date ranges out of the box

alternatives.name: calendar_date_picker2
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you need a standard full-calendar date picker or range selection instead of a weekly horizontal strip.
